title: Increase updates timeline
description: A framed changelog strip: a semibold heading, then the latest posts on a timeline of small square dots joined by a hairline, four across on desktop and down the left edge on phones. Each post has a 16px title, a grey three-line excerpt and a mono date. The newest dot is mint; on hover a post's title underlines and its dot turns lime. An outlined 'more' button closes it.
notes: four posts fill the desktop row; more wrap into further rows
